admitted_claim: All 443 exposure-admissible metadata-WCS pairs were confirmed by exact FITS WCS. The HDU-binding self-audit passed: the exact WCS solution and pixel analysis use HDU 0 with matching 2048x2048 dimensions for every pixel-replayed representative. Among 103 preregistered temporal representative pairs spanning 42 sources, no R1-compatible near-IR point-source counterpart was detected. Ninety-two pair-level no-counterpart results passed both the overlap-frame R1 gate and local coordinate injection sensitivity; 10 pairs remain blocked by local sensitivity and 1 pair is blocked by the overlap-frame R1 gate. At source level, 39/42 sources have at least one sensitivity-qualified no-counterpart representative, while 3/42 remain unresolved.

frozen_exposure_admissible_set.rule: exclude any archive filters string containing blind or PV lens, case-insensitive

frozen_temporal_representatives.rule: per exact-overlap source: prefer standard broad-band archive configurations matching clear z/J/H/K/Ks when available; otherwise use any exposure-admissible exact overlap; select deterministic earliest, median and latest unique files

hdu_binding_self_audit.admission: The specific feared WCS-HDU versus image-HDU mismatch did not occur in RUN-001.
hdu_binding_self_audit.scope: all 443 exact-WCS pairs for WCS HDU/dimensions and all 103 pixel-replayed representative pairs for WCS-to-image HDU/dimension binding

next_gate.goal: Preregister a follow-up restricted to the frozen blocked source/pair set, using additional exact-overlap exposures and/or sensitivity-preserving stacking without changing the admitted 2F-E results, to resolve the 3 fully blocked sources and characterize the 5 mixed sources.
next_gate.name: LUCI-PALOMAR-JPFM-2F-F-UNRESOLVED-SENSITIVITY-RECOVERY

not_admitted: RUN-001 is not a global scientific PASS; the preregistered runner returned exit code 3 and status BLOCKED because one representative frame failed the overlap-frame R1 gate.
The 10 local-sensitivity-blocked pairs are not evidence of absence.
The 3 sources with all selected representatives blocked remain unresolved.
This representative test is not a full archive photometric-completeness analysis.
No anomaly, UAP-origin, artificial-origin, ETI, or causal claim is admitted.

workflow.transport_semantics: GitHub Actions job intentionally preserves and uploads scientific artifacts even when the scientific runner returns nonzero; workflow success is not scientific PASS.
